response.original_title: [FAQs-Complaint] SilverSeas Cruise Line Complaint & Dispute: Refund and Support Guide
response.overview: To file a complaint, request a refund, or escalate a dispute with Silversea Cruises, call customer support at +1-866-254-7549 (US/Canada) or visit the Silversea Contact Us Page to submit your details online. Steps to File and Escalate a Dispute Gather Documents: Collect your booking confirmation number +1-866-254-7549 , voyage details, receipts, folio statements, and any written correspondence. Contact Standard Support: Call +1-866-254-7549  or email customer service to explain the issue clearly and request a written resolution +1-866-254-7549 . Involve Your Travel Advisor: If you booked through an independent travel agency +1-866-254-7549 , Silversea often requires your advisor to manage major booking modifications or refund requests on your behalf. Request an Escalation: If frontline support cannot resolve your issue +1-866-254-7549 , politely ask to be transferred to a supervisor or the customer relations escalation team.
